description: List the device↔service-group membership edges (public.device_service_groups) — the delegation boundary: which devices belong to which service group. Resolves device_name + service_group_name. Filters: `service_group_id`, `device_uuid`, `limit` (default 500, cap 1000). This is the ADMIN-CONTROLLED authz edge (never traffic-derived); it powers "users whose devices are in group X". Gated devices:view. Read-only.

service_group_id.description: Filter to one service group's devices.

name: list_device_service_groups
title: List Device Service Groups
